#include <opencv2/opencv.hpp>
using namespace cv;
using namespace std;
string path_to_image = "path/to/image.png";

// Function to get the bounding box of each object detected in the image
vector<vector<Point>> detectObjects(string image, vector< String > labels, double threshold) {
    // Load the image using OpenCV
    cv::Mat img = imread(image, IMREAD_COLOR);
    if (img.empty()) {
        cout << "Unable to load image." << endl;
        return {};
    }

    // Convert the image to HU (hyperspectral hue) space for color based detection
    cv::hyperspectral::HyperspectralImage hw;
    hw.read(image, HSPH_VALUE_SCALE, HSPH_VALUE_STEP);
    hw.hyperspectralToHu(img, hw.data());

    // Initialize the tracker for multiple detection stages
    Trackers::Tracker* tracker;
    switch (labels.size()) {
        case 1: tracker = new (false) Trackers::Tracker1D(); break;
        case 2: tracker = new (false) Trackers::Tracker2D(); break;
        case 3: tracker = new (false) Trackers::Tracker3D(); break;
        default: tracker = new (false) Trackers::Tracker4D(); break;
    }

    while (true) {
        tracker->setThreshold(threshold);

        // Detect bounding boxes and track instances
        for (Vector<Point> objects : tracker->detect()) {
            Point p;
            PTransform ptrans;
            bool tracked = false;
            if (objects.size()) {
                if (Object_Detector_Tool::detectObjectsFromHyperspectral(image, hw, objects, p, ptrans, tracked)) {
                    // Add to the set of objects detected
                    for (Point& point : objects) {
                        if (tracked) {
                            // Check if an object is already present
                            for (Point& detected_point : objects) {
                                if (p == detected_point)
                                    continue;
                                p = p + (detected_point - p);
                            }
                        }
                        objects.push_back(point);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        std::sort(objects.begin(), objects.end());
        vector<Point> sorted_objects;
        copy(objects.begin(), objects.end(), back_inserter(sorted_objects));
        objects.clear();

        // Delete any objects that no longer exist in the sorted set
        for (int i = 1; i < sorted_objects.size() - 1; i++) {
            if (HyperspectralImage::matches(sorted_objects[i], sorted_objects[i - 1]) &&
                HyperspectralImage::matches(sorted_objects[i], sorted_objects[i + 1])) {
                sorted_objects.erase(sorted_objects.begin() + i);
            }
        }

        // Update the tracker with the sorted set and handle missed detections
        if (sorted_objects.size() > 0) {
            tracker->calibrate(img, hw, sorted_objects);

            // Reset all threshold and model thresholds to avoid interference in subsequent loops
            tracker->setThreshold(1.0 / threshold);
            tracker->setThreshold(1.0 / threshold);
            tracker->setThreshold(1.0 / threshold);
            tracker->setThreshold(1.0 / threshold);
        }
    }

    // Return the bounding boxes of the detected objects as a vector of vectors
    vector<vector<Point>> detected_objects;
    Point p = Point(0, 0);
    double x = 0;
    for (Point& point : sorted_objects) {
        cv::boundingRect(img, point, cv::Size(p.width, p.height), p, cv::Ratio(1, 1), 0, 0);
        cv::rectangle(img, point, cv::Point(0, 0), CvScalar(128, 128, 128), CvThickness(2), 8, 8);
        cv::rectangle(img, point, cv::Point(p.width + 5, p.height + 5), CvScalar(128, 128, 128), CvThickness(2), 8, 8);
        detected_objects.push_back({p, point});
        x = point.x;
        p = Point(point.x + int(p.width), point.y + int(p.height) + 1);
    }
    return detected_objects;
}

// Function to count the number of candlight candle holders present in the image
int countCandlights(vector<vector<Point> > obj) {
    int count = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < obj.size(); i++) {
        Point& p = obj[i];
        PTransform ptrans;
        double s = hyperspectral::calcDistancePoint(p, img, hw, ptrans);
        Point& v = obj[i + 1];
        s = hyperspectral::calcDistancePoint(v, img, hw, ptrans);
        double d = hyperspectral::calcDistFromPoint(s, p, v);
        if (d > 3)
            for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++)
                if (d < hyperspectral::calcCandlight(s - j * int(p.width), v - j * int(p.height))) {
                    count++;
                    break;
                }
    }
    return count;
}

    vector<vector<Point> > obj = detectObjects(path_to_image, {"candlight"}, 0.3);

    vector<vector<Point> > candle_objs = detectObjects(path_to_image, {"candle"}, 0.3);

    int count = countCandlights(candle_objs);

    cout << "Number of candlights: " << count << endl;

    return 0;
}
